entities.summary: Maria Josepa Massanés i Dalmau was a Spanish poet of the nineteenth century, ascribed to the movement of Romanticism. The poetic work of Massanés is characterized by the diversity of themes, love, homeland, religion, social criticism, the situation of women, as well as the precise formal richness.
